commandPalette.$description: CommandPalette's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--command-palette-<name>) on the page, a container or one CommandPalette, and every CommandPalette inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

heading.$description: A group's heading (4.5:1 on the dialog).

divider.$description: The line under the search field.

option-bg-active.$description: The active row's background (its text stays 4.5:1 on it).

list-height.$description: The most the list grows to before it scrolls (320px).
